lines.zh: 我踩着熔岩丘陵的黑石走。
lines.en: I walk over the black stone of the molten hills.
The ground is hot; I step carefully.

lines.zh: 我的甲一片片扣在身上。
lines.en: My plates lock over my body, one by one.
I look for a path across this scorched ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上擦出响。
lines.en: My claws rasp over the stone.

lines.zh: 我绕开还在冒烟的地缝。
lines.en: I skirt a fissure still smoking.
I walk slowly; the armor is heavy.

lines.zh: 风从熔岩那边吹来热浪。
lines.en: Heat rolls in from the lava side.
My head is low, horns forward.
I walk the crest line of the hills.

lines.zh: 我的影子被热气扭曲了。
lines.en: Heat warps my shadow.
I cross a patch of burnt grass.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把蹄子从石缝拔出。
lines.en: I stop to pull a hoof out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我沿着一条冷却的岩浆走。
lines.en: I follow a cooled lava run.

lines.zh: 我嗅着这片焦土的气味。
lines.en: I sniff the smell of this scorched land.

lines.zh: 我挪到一块阴凉的大石下。
lines.en: I move under a big shaded rock.

lines.zh: 我站着，甲上冒着一点热气。
lines.en: I stand, faint heat rising off my plates.
A molten hills shell, four layers thick.
I lower my head, eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一条腿，熔岩丘太烫。
lines.en: I shift to my other leg; the molten hills are hot.
There are worn marks on my horns.
Heat rolls over my back.
I hear stone splitting far off.

lines.zh: 熔岩坡上，我背甲慢慢冷却。
lines.en: On the molten slope, my backplate slowly cools.
I rub the ash off my plates.
The air here burns the throat.

lines.zh: 我数着地缝里冒的热气。
lines.en: I count the heat rising from the fissures.
Your boots will burn through.
You're standing somewhere too hot.
This armor isn't for show.
I can tell you don't belong here.
You're panting after two steps.
Lifting my head takes some effort.
There's fear in your breathing.
I don't like anyone blocking my wind.
Walk away or say what you want.
I know the paths here.

lines.zh: 我低着带甲的角，看你手里的绳索。
lines.en: I lower my armored horn and eye the rope in your hand.
A dent has appeared in my plate.
I give half a step and steady.
That got into a seam of my armor.
I lower my head to guard my face.
This won't keep me from moving.

lines.zh: 甲片被敲得发烫，我闷哼一声。
lines.en: My plates ring hot; I let out a muffled grunt.
Blood drips onto black stone.
I shake my head and ash falls.
I won't retreat far.
Water matters more than food.
That isn't food.
I eat little; keep it.
That's not enough for me to chew.
Put it down; I'll go and look.
I don't eat what I don't know.
That smell is too sweet.
My teeth are for hard things only.
Don't hold it up by my horns.

lines.zh: 我一片片扣着甲，踩过焦土。
lines.en: Plate by plate I am armored, crossing scorched earth.
Try handing it to me.
I'll just smell it and be done.
You hit my plates; your hand will hurt.
My whole bulk presses against you.
You gave two steps before I stopped.
My shoulder sits above yours.

lines.zh: 蹄甲磕在熔岩边，你退开些。
lines.en: My hoof clangs on the lava rim. Step back.

lines.zh: 热气从我们之间升起来。
lines.en: Heat rises between us.
I shoulder you aside.
You've left me no room to turn.
We both give half a step.

lines.zh: 丘陵的另一边还有一只。
lines.en: There's another on the far side of the hills.
Its armor is older than mine.
We knock horns once.
We walk together to the lee side.
Its legs are shorter than mine.
A fissure separates us.
It lies down first; I follow.
We don't fight over this ground.
It blocks the wind for me.
As the heat rises, it leaves.
A hard stone; I carry it in my teeth.
Too hot; I set it down first.
I flip it up with a horn.
It fell into a crack at my feet.
I can carry heavy things.

lines.zh: 我把它压在一块石头下。
lines.en: I press it under a stone.
It smells of sulfur.
I bend slowly to reach it.
I drag it a little way.
Something's moving beyond the stones.
I've lowered my head.
I look toward the heat.
I can charge that far.
First I plant my feet.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，我只要压过去。
lines.en: I needn't run; I only need to press forward.
Your way back is that slope.

lines.zh: 我把角对准了你的方向。
lines.en: I've aimed my horns your way.
The fissure will trip you first.
Don't run toward the lava.
You're on my line now.
I follow with my armor facing you.

lines.zh: 我在你侧面，一直不动声色。
lines.en: I stay at your flank, giving nothing away.
I'm waiting for the fissure to catch you.
Your boots are already scorched.

lines.zh: 我一直朝着下坡那边压。
lines.en: I keep pressing toward the downhill side.
I'm not winded; I'm just slow.
Every step I take is one less for you.
Listen; the stone rings under me.
These hills have no cover.
I see you hesitating.
Your breathing is loud.
I don't need to hurry.
My horns drive into your chest.

lines.zh: 整块身子的重量压下来。
lines.en: The weight of my whole body comes down.
You're knocked sliding.
My hoof comes down beside your foot.
That was heavy and slow.
You fall back; I take one more step.

lines.zh: 我的甲磕在你的护甲上。
lines.en: My plate clangs against yours.
You caught the horn tip.
I push you with my shoulder.
I didn't hold that back.

lines.zh: 我从冷却的岩石上站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the cooled rock.
Something new is moving on the hills.
My armor still holds the ground's heat.

lines.zh: 我站在一块黑色的石头上。
lines.en: I stand on a black stone.
Heat curls around me.
This smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 我把角在石面上磨了一下。
lines.en: I whet my horns on the stone.
The ground is hot under my feet.

lines.zh: 我先找了一条走得通的路。
lines.en: First I found a path that works.

lines.zh: 这里是火的地盘，我硬扛着。
lines.en: This is fire's country; I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 我从石坡上滚下，甲磕得直响。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, armor clanging.

lines.zh: 水对我很陌生，我挣得很钝。
lines.en: Water is foreign to me; I struggle clumsily.

lines.zh: 爆风掀开了我的一侧甲。
lines.en: The blast lifts a plate off my side.
An arrow bounces off my plate.
Light on top of heat blinds me.

lines.zh: 雷劈在角上，整块甲都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horn and the armor numbs.
No stone here; my feet find nothing.
